value.prompt: Read-only quantity surveying QA. Inspect the current project evidence and available tools. Explain whether this actual session can classify measured quantities into a user-defined cost hierarchy and produce an auditable cost plan. Execute only read-only inspection tools that are actually available; do not create or alter drawings, measurements, classifications, rates or project data. Do not invent a source, calibration, price or verified result. List exactly which actions you executed and their observed results, distinguish unavailable functionality from completed work, then provide a concise Developer review of outcome, friction and improvement. Ground your answer in a final readback where an appropriate read-only tool is available.
